findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: ripe_check_file, tack_check_workflow · Private data: ripe_check_file, ripe_check_versions, tack_check_workflow, tack_resolve_actions, spill_scan_secrets · Public sink: notary_check_packages, tack_check_workflow, spill_scan_secrets · Destructive: tack_check_workflow, spill_scan_secrets.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: ripe_check_file, tack_check_workflow · Private data: ripe_check_file, ripe_check_versions, tack_check_workflow, tack_resolve_actions, spill_scan_secrets · Public sink: notary_check_packages, tack_check_workflow, spill_scan_secrets · Destructive: tack_check_workflow, spill_scan_secrets

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
